## BigDecimal

Operands of *digits* decimal digits at working *precision*, so that
precision grows with the operands. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter. `round` drops the
low half of the operand; `parse` builds the value from its string.

Verified this run: decimo and libmpdec produce the same
2000-digit product from the same 1000-digit operands.

| Digits / precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | | CPython `decimal` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 / 28 | add | 41.5 ns | 33.9 ns | 1.22× slower | 46.0 ns | **1.11× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | subtract | 43.9 ns | 29.8 ns | 1.47× slower | 45.7 ns | parity |
| 9 / 28 | multiply | 41.1 ns | 26.4 ns | 1.56× slower | 43.7 ns | **1.06× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | divide | 131.2 ns | 49.3 ns | 2.66× slower | 67.4 ns | 1.95× slower |
| 9 / 28 | round | 38.2 ns | 31.1 ns | 1.23× slower | 69.9 ns | **1.83× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | parse | 88.4 ns | 40.5 ns | 2.18× slower | 77.9 ns | 1.13× slower |

## sqrt, exp, ln, power

A fixed set, chosen before the results were seen. `2.3456789`, and
`** 1.5` for power. 100 000 digits is left out because `mpd_exp`
needs 82 seconds there and `mpd_ln` 239 seconds.

| Precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28 | sqrt | 2.51 µs | 872.6 ns | 2.88× slower |
| 28 | exp | 4.08 µs | 4.49 µs | **1.10× faster** |
| 28 | ln | 4.37 µs | 12.81 µs | **2.93× faster** |
| 28 | power | 10.66 µs | 35.46 µs | **3.33× faster** |
| 100 | sqrt | 4.12 µs | 4.09 µs | parity |
| 100 | exp | 10.00 µs | 14.90 µs | **1.49× faster** |
| 100 | ln | 69.74 µs | 39.25 µs | 1.78× slower |
| 100 | power | 89.62 µs | 80.85 µs | 1.11× slower |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 43.64 µs | 214.48 µs | **4.91× faster** |
| 1,000 | exp | 386.56 µs | 4.45 ms | **11.50× faster** |
| 1,000 | ln | 2.85 ms | 5.56 ms | **1.95× faster** |
| 1,000 | power | 3.31 ms | 11.21 ms | **3.39× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 1.18 ms | 23.11 ms | **19.60× faster** |
| 10,000 | exp | 56.78 ms | 1.381 s | **24.32× faster** |
| 10,000 | ln | 260.54 ms | 3.256 s | **12.50× faster** |
| 10,000 | power | 319.28 ms | 4.691 s | **14.69× faster** |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.
Division is 2n-by-n; two operands of the same width would give a
one-digit quotient and measure nothing.

| Digits | Operation | decimo | CPython `int` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | add | 33.2 ns | 27.7 ns | 1.20× slower |
| 100 | multiply | 76.3 ns | 110.6 ns | **1.45× faster** |
| 100 | floor divide | 376.9 ns | 309.3 ns | 1.22× slower |
| 100 | sqrt | 470.5 ns | 308.3 ns | 1.53× slower |
| 1,000 | add | 51.8 ns | 90.8 ns | **1.75× faster** |
| 1,000 | multiply | 1.10 µs | 5.55 µs | **5.02× faster** |
| 1,000 | floor divide | 8.38 µs | 12.71 µs | **1.52× faster** |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 4.07 µs | 4.52 µs | **1.11× faster** |
| 10,000 | add | 265.0 ns | 765.2 ns | **2.89× faster** |
| 10,000 | multiply | 52.48 µs | 265.44 µs | **5.06× faster** |
| 10,000 | floor divide | 163.77 µs | 546.29 µs | **3.34× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 101.84 µs | 268.39 µs | **2.64× faster** |
| 100,000 | add | 2.65 µs | 7.86 µs | **2.97× faster** |
| 100,000 | multiply | 1.19 ms | 8.81 ms | **7.38× faster** |
| 100,000 | floor divide | 4.66 ms | 18.05 ms | **3.87× faster** |
| 100,000 | sqrt | 2.68 ms | 8.41 ms | **3.14× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | add | 24.50 µs | 76.27 µs | **3.11× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | multiply | 23.63 ms | 373.15 ms | **15.79× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | floor divide | 116.58 ms | 747.62 ms | **6.41× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | sqrt | 69.49 ms | 344.65 ms | **4.96× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| Digits | decimo | mpmath + GMP | MPFR | mpmath (pure Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 8.01 µs | 39.00 µs | 39.17 µs | 32.79 µs |
| 1,000 | 66.52 µs | 102.21 µs | 68.00 µs | 162.08 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.24 ms | 844.17 µs | 710.04 µs | 5.92 ms |
| 100,000 | 34.81 ms | 15.25 ms | 23.10 ms | 184.09 ms |
| 1,000,000 | 841.53 ms | 264.45 ms | 425.68 ms | 8.518 s |
